title: Among accounts opened in districts where the average salary exceeds $10,000
question: Among accounts opened in districts where the average salary exceeds $10,000, find those that have a monthly statement issuance frequency and are associated with at least one loan approved between 1995 and 1997 for an amount of $250,000 or more. For these accounts, calculate the percentage of female clients.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_010 = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.XCL_009) AS female_percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
JOIN disp dp ON a.XCL_001 = dp.XCL_015
JOIN client c ON dp.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND d.XCL_017 IN (
    SELECT XCL_017 FROM district GROUP BY XCL_017 HAVING AVG(XCL_031) > 10000
  )
  AND a.XCL_001 IN (
    SELECT XCL_034 FROM loan
    WHERE XCL_035 BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
      AND XCL_036 >= 250000
  )

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_010 = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.XCL_009) AS female_percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
JOIN disp dp ON a.XCL_001 = dp.XCL_015
JOIN client c ON dp.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND d.XCL_017 IN (
    SELECT XCL_017 FROM district GROUP BY XCL_017 HAVING AVG(XCL_031) > 10000
  )
  AND a.XCL_001 IN (
    SELECT XCL_034 FROM loan
    WHERE XCL_035 BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
      AND XCL_036 >= 250000
  )
